dietPlan.planTitle: AI & Doctor Prescribed Vata-Kapha Pacifying Diet
dietPlan.doshaTarget: Vata-Kapha Balance (Warm, Unctuous, Light, Easy Digesting)
dietPlan.assignedByDoctor: Dr. Shrikant Sharma (Validated by AyurSutra Clinical AI)
dietaryGuidelines: All meals must be consumed warm and freshly prepared within 3 hours of cooking.
Maintain a 4-hour gap between primary meals to allow complete digestion of previous food.
Drink sips of warm water infused with cumin and ginger during meals; avoid drinking large amounts of water immediately after eating.
Incorporate 1 teaspoon of A2 Gir Cow Ghee into your lunch and dinner.

items: Warm Moong Dal Khichdi OR Soft Steamed Ragi Porridge with Jaggery
mealPlan.precautions: Avoid fermented bakery bread, eggs, or deep fried snacks.

Steamed Bottle Gourd (Lauki) / Ridge Gourd (Turai) sabzi

mealPlan.precautions: Strictly avoid commercially packaged snacks and cold aerated drinks.

mealPlan.precautions: Dinner must be finished at least 2.5 hours before sleeping. Never sleep immediately after dinner.

forbiddenFoods: Cold water, ice creams, iced beverages
Nightshades in excess (Tomatoes, Brinjal / Eggplant, Potatoes)
Raw sprouts and unboiled salads at night (causes Vata bloating)
Deep fried, refined flour (Maida), and processed junk food
permittedDrinks: Lukewarm water boiled with Cumin & Fennel seeds
Fresh Takra (Spiced Buttermilk with roasted cumin and mint)
Warm Almond Milk with a pinch of Nutmeg & Cardamom (at bedtime)
lifestyleTips: Sleep by 10:00 PM and wake up before sunrise (Brahma Muhurta ~ 06:00 AM).
Gentle lumbar stretches (Bhujangasana, Marjariasana) only under therapist guidance.
Never suppress natural biological urges (Adharaneeya Vegas).

generalPrecautions: Strictly avoid cold wind/drafts and high AC settings (keep room at 25-26°C minimum).
Use a firm mattress with thin pillow to maintain natural cervical-lumbar curvature.
Do not bathe with cold water during the entire 7-day therapy regimen.
